Branch claude/investigate-metrics-collection-VQKg4 was successfully merged via PR #244 (commit 74a5adcf).

- ML hooks may not be running - no new sessions captured since Dec 27
- Recommendation: Add ML hooks to global settings with cwd:Opus-code-test matcher

### ✅ Baseline Stats Verified
- Sessions: 186, Commits: 2421, Chats: 19
- Stats command works correctly

### ✅ Test Isolation PASSED
- Ran test_file_prediction_experiment_get_metric_history
- metrics.jsonl still has exactly 10 lines (no pollution)
- Fixture patching for temp_experiments_dir is working correctly

## What Worked
- Test isolation fix is effective
- Documentation is clear
- Handoff instructions were comprehensive

## What Needs Attention
- Hook configuration still has global/local conflict
- Sessions not being captured (last entry Dec 27)
- May need manual hook configuration in global settings
